name: Binary measurement decoder
task_prompt: Decode measurement-register bits in most-significant-bit-first order. bit_register_to_int returns the ordinary unsigned base-2 integer represented by a non-empty list of 0/1 values and raises ValueError for an empty register or any non-binary value. measurement_register_to_phase returns bit_register_to_int(bits) divided by 2**len(bits), using the same validation.
